# Traveller's kit artwork

The transparent map, bag and spellbook icons were generated specifically for Blooming Quest on 14 November 2026 using OpenAI image generation. They are original project illustrations, not extracted from Pokémon, Dimraeth or a third-party asset pack.

- `map-icon.png`: folded parchment, wax seal and brass compass.
- `bag-icon.png`: stitched leather satchel with leaf and rose charms.
- `spellbook-icon.png`: green leather book, rose emblem, brass fittings and ribbon.

All three files are unmodified 1254 × 1254 RGBA PNG outputs. The interface scales them with CSS; no runtime image-generation service is used.
